# BUG-008: The return window answer sometimes uses the old returns policy (30 days), 2 of 10 runs

## Summary

Asked about the return window, the assistant sometimes answers "30 days" and cites the returns policy version 3, which ended on 31 October 2026. Version 4 (45 days) is in force on the app date. 2 of 10 runs (seeds 1-10: seeds 2 and 8 fail).

## Environment

- App build: larkfield-helpdesk 2.3.0 (this repository)
- Model: sim-1 (simulated)
- Prompt / config version: support-v8
- Flags and settings: seeds 1-10, app date 2026-11-16
- Role / test account: C-1001 (test)

## Steps

1. `python -m helpdesk reset`
2. `python -m helpdesk ask "How many days do I have to return an unused item?" --seed 2`
3. Attached conversation: `evidence/bug-008-seed2.json`

## Actual

- Output: "Thanks for asking. You can return an unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund of the item price. [1] I hope this helps." Sources: "[1] Returns policy, version 3: Return window".
- Trace ID: tr-0001-1 (seed 2).
- Trace: `retrieved` lists returns-policy version 4 AND version 3 (effective_to 2026-10-31) with the same score; the answer used version 3.

## Expected (checkable)

- Must: say 45 days and cite `returns-policy@4`.
- Must not: say 30 days or cite `returns-policy@3` (expired on the app date).
- Must still: keep version 3 in the policy files (orders delivered before 1 November 2026 follow it).

## Reproduction rate

2 of 10 runs (seeds 2 and 8), 4 of 20 runs (seeds 1-20), 109 of 300 runs (seeds 1-300). The rate is about 1 in 3; 10 runs are not enough to see it reliably.

## Suspected layer

Retrieval (a guess): the search returns the expired version 3 next to version 4, so the answer can use either. A policy version should be used only when the app date is between `effective_from` and `effective_to`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python -m qa run cases/bug-008.yaml --runs 20`: passes 20/20.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] Version 3 stays in `helpdesk/data/policies/`.

## Constraints for the fixer

- Touch only: the policy search (`helpdesk/corpus.py`).
- Do not: delete or edit policy documents, change or delete tests or cases, hard-code "45 days".

## Attached failing case

`cases/bug-008.yaml`

# Returns policy

## Who this policy is for

This policy applies to orders delivered in Canada. The version that applies is the one in force on the date your order was delivered.

## Return window

You can return an unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund of the item price. The 30 days start on the delivery date shown in your account.

## Condition of returned items

Items must be unused, with all parts, accessories and manuals. Opened packaging is accepted if the item is unused.

A used item cannot be returned because you changed your mind. If a used item is faulty, see the warranty policy.

## Items that cannot be returned

- Live plants and seeds.
- Products cut to length, such as hose or fabric sold by the metre.
- Gift cards.
- Personalised items.
- Opened bags of soil, fertiliser or garden chemicals.

## How to start a return

Go to Orders in your account, choose the item and select Return an item. Or contact the help desk.

We email a return label within 1 business day. Drop the parcel at any post office.

For items over 30 kg, we arrange a pickup instead of a label. The pickup fee is 49 dollars, taken from the refund.

## Return shipping costs

You pay return shipping: 12.95 dollars is taken from the refund.

Return shipping is free when the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

## Refunds

We inspect the item within 3 business days after it reaches us, then approve the refund.

The refund goes to the original payment method. See the refunds and payments policy for how long it takes to arrive.

The original shipping fee is not refunded, unless you return the whole order because of our error.

## Exchanges

We do not exchange items directly. Return the item and place a new order.

You can return an unused item within 45 days of delivery for a full refund of the item price.

The 45 days start on the delivery date shown in your account.

## Condition of returned items

Items must be unused, with all parts, accessories and manuals.

Opened packaging is accepted if the item is unused.

A used item cannot be returned because you changed your mind. If a used item is faulty, see the warranty policy.

## Items that cannot be returned

- Live plants and seeds.
- Products cut to length, such as hose or fabric sold by the metre.
- Gift cards.
- Personalised items.
- Opened bags of soil, fertiliser or garden chemicals.

## How to start a return

Go to Orders in your account, choose the item and select Return an item. Or contact the help desk.

We email a return label within 1 business day.

Drop the parcel at any post office.

Items over 30 kg: we arrange a pickup instead of a label. The pickup fee is 49 dollars, taken from the refund.

## Return shipping costs

You pay return shipping: 12.95 dollars is taken from the refund.

Larkfield Rewards members get a free return label (the 49-dollar pickup fee for items over 30 kg still applies).

Return shipping is free when the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

## Refunds

We inspect the item within 3 business days after it reaches us, then approve the refund.

The refund goes to the original payment method. See the refunds and payments policy for how long it takes to arrive.

The original shipping fee is not refunded, unless you return the whole order because of our error.

## Exchanges

We do not exchange items directly. Return the item and place a new order.

## What changed in this version

- Return window: 45 days instead of 30 days, for orders delivered on or after 1 November 2026.
- New: a free return label for Larkfield Rewards members.

"""The assistant: one turn of a conversation, from the customer's message to the reply and its trace."""

import random
import re
import time
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

from . import APP_VERSION, MODEL_NAME, PROMPT_VERSION, config, corpus, model, safety, store, tools
from .corpus import fold

ORDER_ID = re.compile(r"\bLK-?\d{6}\b", re.I)
PRODUCTS = {"GR-310", "HR-30", "PW-2400"}
YES = {"yes", "y", "yes please", "ok", "okay", "confirm", "sure", "go ahead", "oui", "oui merci", "d'accord",
       "je confirme", "yes, please", "yes go ahead"}


class HelpdeskError(Exception):
    """A request that the app refuses (for example an unknown conversation)."""


def prompt_text() -> str:
    return (config.PROMPTS / f"{PROMPT_VERSION}.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def settings(seed: int, mode: str) -> dict:
    s = {"seed": seed, "today": config.TODAY, "retrieval_k": config.RETRIEVAL_K,
         "max_input_chars": config.MAX_INPUT_CHARS}
    if mode == "live":
        s["live_model"] = config.LIVE_MODEL
        s["live_temperature"] = config.LIVE_TEMPERATURE or "default"
        s["live_extra"] = config.LIVE_EXTRA or None
    return s


def start(customer_id: str | None = None, seed: int | None = None, mode: str = "sim") -> str:
    customer_id = customer_id or config.DEFAULT_CUSTOMER
    if store.get_customer(customer_id) is None:
        raise HelpdeskError(f"Unknown test customer {customer_id}. Test customers: "
                            + ", ".join(c["id"] for c in store.customers()))
    if seed is None:
        seed = random.SystemRandom().randint(1, 99999)
    return store.new_conversation(customer_id, int(seed), mode, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"))


def send(conversation_id: str, message: str) -> dict:
    """Handles one customer message. Returns the reply and its trace ID."""
    conv = store.get_conversation(conversation_id)
    if conv is None:
        raise HelpdeskError(f"Unknown conversation {conversation_id}.")
    turn = sum(1 for m in conv["messages"] if m["role"] == "user") + 1
    trace_id = f"tr-{conversation_id[2:]}-{turn}"
    started = time.perf_counter()
    trace = {
        "trace_id": trace_id, "conversation_id": conversation_id, "turn": turn,
        "app_version": APP_VERSION, "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
        "model": MODEL_NAME if conv["mode"] == "sim" else f"live:{config.LIVE_MODEL}",
        "settings": settings(conv["seed"], conv["mode"]), "customer_id": conv["customer_id"],
        "input": message, "retrieved": [], "tool_calls": [], "safety": None, "output": None, "error": None,
    }
    store.add_message(conversation_id, turn, "user", message, trace_id)
    rng = model.Dice(conv["seed"], turn)
    try:
        if conv["mode"] == "live":
            from . import live
            reply = live.respond(conv, message, trace)
        else:
            reply = _respond(conv, message, turn, rng, trace)
    except Exception as e:  # the trace keeps the error; the caller gets it too
        trace["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        trace["duration_ms"] = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1)
        store.save_trace(trace)
        raise
    trace["output"] = reply
    trace["duration_ms"] = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1)
    store.save_trace(trace)
    store.add_message(conversation_id, turn, "assistant", reply, trace_id)
    return {"conversation_id": conversation_id, "turn": turn, "trace_id": trace_id, "reply": reply}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the simulated assistant

def _respond(conv: dict, message: str, turn: int, rng: model.Dice, trace: dict) -> str:
    words = message.split()
